title: FoundryAccountList
description: Per-driver account list for intelligence-supervisor. Each file covers one provider family (Claude / Codex / Gemini). Parsed by account-kernel:48 parser — provider_family MUST be CamelCase. No raw credentials; all secrets via sref:// OpenBao references per ADR-0067.

_meta.n_threshold_note: Drift-detection lane (lean-settings-drift) is feature-flagged off in production until sum(rows across registry/accounts/*.toml) >= 10. Before threshold: lane runs against fixture files only in CI (passes vacuously for empty fleet). Threshold checked at lane start via: wc -l registry/accounts/*.toml | tail -1 | awk '{print $1}'. Per v5 §A.1.2 + §C.26.

account.description: List of provider accounts for this driver. Priority 1 = highest priority (selected first when multiple accounts available).

account_id.description: Unique account identifier. Format: acct-NNN (zero-padded 3 digits). Must be unique within the workspace.

provider_family.description: Provider family. MUST be CamelCase — account-kernel:48 parser is case-sensitive. Canonical values: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google.

display_name.description: Human-readable account name shown in logs and HUD.

secret_ref.description: OpenBao secret reference. Format: sref://openbao/<mount>/<path>. Never a raw key. Per ADR-0067 secret-reference-openbao-pattern.

autonomy_tier_ceiling.description: Maximum autonomy tier this account may be invoked at. Enforced by autonomy-ceiling Cedar policy at runtime. T1=read/suggest only; T2=write with human approval; T3=automated write; T4=disabled by default.

cost_ceiling_tokens.description: Rolling token budget (input + output combined). Supervisor enforces via UsageEnforcement::check_limit. 0 = unlimited (not recommended for production).

priority.description: Account selection priority. Lower number = higher priority. Supervisor selects lowest-priority-number account with available capacity.

model_hint.description: Optional preferred model override for this account. If absent, supervisor uses driver default.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for grouping / filtering accounts in dashboards.
